real_defects.issue: The browser checks (checks, linenet, tax, adjustment, breakdown, ubl, cii, isdoc) parsed amounts with Number(), which reads '0x64' as 100, '0b11' as 3 and '0o7' as 7: a UBL/CII/JSON invoice with hex amounts passed the page clean while the Python CLI flagged INV-009/010/013 and a receiver (xs:decimal) rejects it. Fixed with numbers.mjs (one decimal pattern shared with numbers.py); numbers.test.mjs fails 3 tests without the fix.

A UBL amount that is not a number raised decimal.InvalidOperation (an ArithmeticError, not the ValueError cli.py catches), so a directory run crashed with a traceback instead of listing one unreadable file. Fixed: ubl._number raises ValueError via parse_decimal; tests/test_numbers.py.

_cents did int(float(gross)), so a gross of 'inf', 'nan' or '1e400' on any credit note or its invoice raised OverflowError/ValueError and killed a directory run. Fixed with parse_decimal and Decimal rounding; tests/test_numbers.py.

A quantity of 1e27 (or a 26-digit amount) overflowed Decimal's default 28-digit context when the line was rounded to cents, so check_invoice raised InvalidOperation. Fixed: amounts of 1e15 or more are not read as numbers (both sides), and check_invoice runs at 80 digits; tests/test_numbers.py.

browser-test runs `node --test` without slimdom/fontoxpath, so 45 tests of the official PINT/ZATCA/plain-runner route (report-plain-route, pint, zatca, pint-current and others) are always skipped in CI; mutants at report.mjs:123 and :150 survived because of it. Fix: add `npm i --no-save --no-package-lock slimdom@4.3.5 fontoxpath@3.34.0` before `node --test` in the browser-test job (suite goes 5 s -> 12 s, all 1432 pass locally). Control plane: its own PR, owner approval.
